purpose: R2 task-applicability study after a bounded TM02 Fig.14 reimplementation: separate data quantity from recovery excitation, then evaluate complete physical histories. This is a plan, not completed training.
implementation_note: Implement a small study entrypoint by reusing existing TM02 material, reference, multihistory training and deployment solvers. The entrypoint does not yet exist in this plan commit.

base.inherit: Reference Table 1 parameters and Eq.29 interpretation, potentials, auxiliary LSTM, losses, Adam schedule, tensor convention and deployment solver.

scientific_questions: Does adding 900 random histories repair the observed noisy recovery bias?
Does replacing 50 random histories with 50 recovery-informative histories repair it at the same observation-increment budget?
Do changes persist across three training-noise realizations and unseen physical loading conditions?

training.ideal_repetitions: one set of five initializations per arm; do not duplicate clean data for noise realization IDs
training.loss: Existing Eq.23-25 stress MAE plus Biot consistency MAE; equal mean over histories, time increments and six components.
training.optimizer_update: Accumulate the correctly averaged gradient of the complete arm dataset before one Adam update. B uses all 1000 histories per update.
training.normalization: Reuse all saved norm fields from the second-round ideal/noisy weights, per condition, identically for all arms and all noise realizations. No evaluation-derived scales, no re-estimation, no clipping outside normalized [-1,1].
training.selection: Within each arm and each ideal/noisy-realization cell, minimum final training loss among the fixed five initializations. Do not select across noise realizations.
training.compute_note: B is a fixed-update data-scale comparison and uses about 10x history-gradient work per update; do not claim equal-compute superiority. Record actual runtime.

arms.source: Reuse every original 100x100 training time/strain/clean-stress array from the second-round archive.
First 100 histories are exact archived A arrays; append 900 histories using the unchanged random generator.
Reuse exact A history indices 0..49; replace indices 50..99 with the 50 full stress-controlled histories below. Train on observed strain/stress/time, not reference internal state.

training_noise.definition: Independent Gaussian observation noise per time increment and stress component, including unloaded portions. Ideal remains clean.

realizations.first_100: Reuse the archived noise arrays exactly.

training_noise.pairing: A/B shared 100 histories and A/C shared 50 histories reuse identical noise arrays per realization. Fixed arrays are shared by all five initializations.
training_noise.scope: Three noise realizations give limited training-noise sensitivity evidence, not deployment sensor-noise robustness or fifteen independent noise datasets.

recovery_training.amplitude_definition: a is a physical stress component amplitude, not equal Frobenius tensor norm across modes
recovery_training.delay_assignment: cycle the five delays within each mode; draw the two amplitudes using the corresponding independent parameter seed
recovery_training.remainder: zero external stress until exactly 5 s
recovery_training.state: virgin equilibrium only at the beginning; preserve each material state's complete evolution through unload, recovery and probe
recovery_training.generation: Independent Reference under prescribed stress produces observable strain and stress; noise is then applied to observed stress. Do not clamp strain during zero-load recovery.

known_diagnostics.random_histories: Reuse original second-round 20 evaluation histories; these are now development diagnostics, not fresh tests.
known_diagnostics.revisit_histories: Reuse all 12 original reference stress-control histories.
known_diagnostics.models: All 60 study models, retaining initialization and noise-realization axes.
known_diagnostics.dual_boundary_replay: For each original stress-control history, replay its reference strain as prescribed strain to predict stress, and separately replay its prescribed stress to predict strain. Both predictions independently propagate their own q from the virgin start; do not inject reference q or intermediate state.
known_diagnostics.response_outputs: Full curves, recovery-tail and reload errors, candidate center and difference; local zero-state tangent moduli, viscosity and observable free-recovery poles from learned potentials.

final_evaluation.reference_material: Fixed original Table 1 parameters; this is not cross-material or real-terrain robustness.
final_evaluation.selected_model_rule: one ideal plus one per each of three noisy realizations, for each of three arms

families.generator: Unchanged original random spline generator; use a fresh disjoint seed set.
Generate each base path with the F1 250x0.05 s rule, apply one amplitude and time scale, evaluate its same continuous spline on dt=0.01 s with an exact final endpoint.
families.statistical_unit: 5 base path seeds reused across the 20 factor combinations; cluster by base path, not 100 independent random samples.

families.note: This is strain-constrained relaxation; the post-unload stress can be nonzero. Do not label it zero-stress free recovery.

families.prefix: Each seed defines a 1 s uniaxial preload with peak drawn uniformly from [0.75,5.5] MPa and the old [0,.1,.4,.5,1] s envelope. Reuse it across its grid cells.
families.directions: sigma11 negative; sigma12 alternates sign each cycle at the specified ratio; all other prescribed stresses zero
families.statistical_unit: 5 independent prefix seeds with a prescribed parameter grid; cluster comparisons by prefix seed.

families.preload_and_probe_template: Use the original r2-revisit.json 1 s envelopes, changing only their peaks.
families.candidates: Use the unchanged early/late 1 s candidates from r2-revisit.json: equal peak 6 MPa, equal integral 2.4 MPa*s.
families.note: 100 same-prefix candidate pairs, not 200 independent physical starts. Reference may still always prefer early; preserve that outcome.
families.heldout_note: The five delays differ from all original diagnostic delays (0.05,0.5,5 s); no final full waveform duplicates the known twelve revisit histories.
families.near_equilibrium_rule: If the reference candidate gap is at or below 1e-6 strain, classify it as reference near-tie / decayed memory. Do not count it as strong ordering evidence or compute a response ratio.

metrics.ratio_rule: For dimensionless strain response or recovery ratios, require |reference| > 1e-6 strain; otherwise report absolute errors and ties. Keep dimensional integral errors as primary and do not divide them by the strain floor.
metrics.primary_comparison: Report each family and each noise realization separately, plus paired arm differences. Raw MPa and strain units are primary; no model-specific NRMSE comparison.
metrics.statistics: 600 fixed physical conditions are not 600 IID draws. Do not count models, adjacent time points or two candidates as independent replications. Any aggregate represents only the declared family weighting.
metrics.failure_policy: Retain all failed model-history cells with the last complete time and stated reason; do not delete or silently replace a family.

interpretation.paper_scope: Selected original TM02 ideal multi-history method can be frozen as bounded reproduction; this study is a project extension, not a new paper-method reproduction or a new algorithm claim.
interpretation.A_vs_B: effect of 10x random training-history amount under the fixed update rule, with extra compute disclosed
interpretation.A_vs_C: effect of replacing half the history budget with recovery excitation, with the same number of observed increments and the same network/loss/scales
interpretation.if_C_helps: supports information/coverage explanation, not algorithm novelty
interpretation.if_B_helps: supports data quantity as an effective remedy; retain that result without forcing C to win
interpretation.if_neither_helps: retain failure and focus the next single study on noise-related identification; do not automatically add losses, networks or more runs
interpretation.S_boundary: No robot, MPC or RL benefit is claimed. After this bounded study, use an explicitly supported material domain for contact mapping and oracle task evaluation before full closed-loop learning.

required: all 50 new weights and optimizer states
all final model-history predictions and failures
per-family paired tables and complete curves
local tangent/recovery quantities with derivation and scope
source/config hashes, compute record and downloadable archive
